HOW SENTINEL WORKS

Evidence first. Certainty earned.

This version checks all eight audit dimensions using contextual keywords, detects placeholders and conflicting labeled fields, and profiles CSV structure. It does not perform unrestricted semantic reasoning or establish legal compliance.

Missing wording is a review candidate, never proof that a control does not exist. All five scoring axes must be supplied before a numerical priority is shown. The effort axis measures the cheapest verification step, not a full fix.
